comments.text:
War in 1967? What is she on about? India honored the Indus water treaty and she cries about irregularities. Now, they have lost that as well. About the pak actors/actress being banned, the so called Right wing BJP, when they came to power, Modi literally went to Pakistan to improve ties and start a new story but Pak sponsored terrorism was what we got in return and we of course can't risk having Pakistanis in India.

I hope we don't go back to the India 10-12 years ago where terror attacks were a normality. You guys betrayed Indians by going communal and inducing riots, got a new country carved out, just on the basis of religion. Deal with it. I hope the Pakistanis acknowledge what is happening and get their facts right and thrive as a nation. Being factual, confronting the reality of whatever your situation maybe is the first step.
